## What changed and why

## How it was checked

- [ ] `yarn lint`, `yarn typecheck` and `yarn test` pass
- [ ] Browser tests pass (`yarn test:e2e`), or the change does not touch anything a person sees or does
- [ ] New text is in every language file in `lib/i18n/`
- [ ] Colour or theme changes keep `yarn audit:contrast` clean
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under **Unreleased** for user-visible changes
